name: Tiszalúc (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and red in the ratio 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszalúc (a red shield with a white charge, with a helm, a sabre crest and red, yellow and blue mantling) above the name TISZALÚC in red.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszalúc arms with helm, crest and mantling
